summary.zh: 用 Turborepo、Nx 与 pnpm 管理多包仓库
summary.en: Manage multi-package repos with Turborepo, Nx, pnpm

description.zh: 说明如何用 Turborepo、Nx 和 pnpm workspaces 组织多包仓库，包括依赖提升、构建编排与共享依赖管理。适合从零搭建单仓或整合分散的仓库时参考。
description.en: Organize multi-package repos with Turborepo, Nx, and pnpm workspaces, covering dependency hoisting, build orchestration, and shared deps. Suited to new monorepos or consolidating existing repos.
